title: Best Practices in the Creation and Use of Emotion Lexicons
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspect of religion or faith. Its focus is on the practical and ethical considerations for creating and using emotion lexicons, discussing biases in a general socio-cultural context without specific examples related to religion.
